info.title: LMA–Sub2API proposed OpenAI subset and multimodal extensions
info.description: DESIGN ONLY. Not implemented by LMA v0.3.11 or the audited Sub2API deployment. Automatic discovery of downloaded/configured local models, standard models/chat/image/speech subset and explicitly namespaced LMA async extensions. All inference remains on one Android phone. Responses, historical Videos and Realtime are not advertised.
